lessons.title: Family

sentences.target: У неё есть муж, сын и дочь.
sentences.english: She has a husband, a son and a daughter.
sentences.translit: U neyo yest' muzh, syn i doch'.

fills.english: Dad is the husband, and mum is the wife.
A son and a daughter are children.

fills.before: Это семья: мама, папа, сын и
fills.english: This is the family: mum, dad, son and daughter.

lessons.tip: Guess the gender from the ending: a consonant = he (брат), -а/-я = she (сестра, бабушка), -о/-е = it. One sneaky exception: дедушка ends in -а but is a man.

lessons.title: My, your, our
lessons.tip: мой/моя/моё copy the gender of the thing owned, not the owner: мой брат, моя сестра. его, её, их never change.

lessons.title: People

sentences.english: A man and a woman are people.
A boy and a girl are children.
There are people here. There is a car there.

fills.english: This is my neighbour. He is a student.
A boy and a girl are children.

lessons.tip: Plurals: add -ы/-и: стол → столы. Some are irregular and just learned whole: друг → друзья, человек → люди.

lessons.title: Describing people

sentences.english: Our grandpa is old but cheerful.

lessons.tip: Adjectives copy the noun: -ый/-ой for he (новый брат), -ая for she (новая сестра), -ое for it. Plural is -ые: новые друзья.

lessons.title: Age & life

sentences.target: Я не женат, но у меня есть подруга.
sentences.english: I'm not married, but I have a girlfriend.
sentences.translit: Ya ne zhenat, no u menya yest' podruga.

lessons.tip: Age is a chunk: Мне + number + год (1) / года (2–4) / лет (5+). Мне тридцать лет. Don't decline it, just copy the pattern.

lessons.title: Telling time

fills.english: It's still early, I want to sleep.

lines.english: Excuse me, what time is it?

lessons.tip: Который час? literally means 'which hour?'. Answer with Сейчас + number + час / часа / часов (1 / 2–4 / 5+), the same pattern as лет.

lessons.title: Days of the week

sentences.target: Вчера была суббота, а сегодня воскресенье.
sentences.english: Yesterday was Saturday and today is Sunday.
sentences.translit: Vchera byla subbota, a sevodnya voskresen'ye.

sentences.english: On Saturday I want to sleep.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

fills.english: Today is Monday and tomorrow is Tuesday.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
Today is Friday and tomorrow is Saturday.
On Saturday I want to sleep.

lessons.tip: Days are written with a small letter (понедельник). To say 'on a day' use в + day: в понедельник, в пятницу, в субботу. Среда, пятница, суббота change to -у: в среду.

lessons.title: Months

sentences.target: В январе холодно, а в июле хорошо.
sentences.english: It's cold in January and nice in July.
sentences.translit: V yanvare kholodno, a v iyule khorosho.

sentences.english: Is it March or April now?

sentences.target: Мой друг в Италии в сентябре.
sentences.english: My friend is in Italy in September.
sentences.translit: Moy drug v Italii v sentyabre.

fills.english: My brother is in England in July.

lines.target: У тебя день рождения в ноябре?
lines.translit: U tebya den' rozhdeniya v noyabre?

lessons.tip: Months are lowercase and masculine. 'In a month' = в + month ending in -е: в январе, в июне, в ноябре. Chunks: в мае, в сентябре.

lessons.title: Daily rhythm

sentences.english: In the morning I want coffee.
In the evening I want to sleep.
In the afternoon I'm at the bank.

sentences.target: В среду у меня есть время.
sentences.translit: V sredu u menya yest' vremya.

sentences.target: На этой неделе я в магазине.
sentences.english: This week I'm at the shop.
sentences.translit: Na etoy nedele ya v magazine.

fills.english: In the morning coffee, in the evening wine.
At night I want to sleep.

lines.english: Do you have time in the evening?
Yes, in the evening I do.

replyOptions: В среду нет, а в четверг да.

lessons.tip: Parts of the day: утром, днём, вечером, ночью (-ом/-ью). Learn them as chunks. For days use в + day: в понедельник, в среду.

lessons.title: Making plans

sentences.target: Я занят в понедельник, но свободен во вторник.
sentences.english: I'm busy on Monday but free on Tuesday.
sentences.translit: Ya zanyat v ponedel'nik, no svoboden vo vtornik.

lessons.tip: Давай + verb = let's: давай встретимся, давай пойдём. Short, friendly, and you can say it without conjugating anything.

lessons.title: Clothes

sentences.target: У него есть рубашка и брюки.
sentences.english: He has a shirt and trousers.
sentences.translit: U nevo yest' rubashka i bryuki.

lines.english: What do you want to buy?
I want to buy a jacket.

lessons.tip: Some clothes only exist in the plural: джинсы, брюки, кроссовки, носки. They take plural words too: новые джинсы, мои брюки.

lessons.title: Colours

sentences.english: The bread is white and the coffee is black.

lessons.tip: Colours are adjectives, so they change like -ый/-ая/-ое: красный телефон, красная куртка, красное платье, красные джинсы.

lessons.title: Sizes & fit

sentences.target: Мне мало. Дайте другой размер, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: It's too small for me. Give me another size, please.
sentences.translit: Mne malo. Dayte drugoy razmer, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: The trousers are long and the skirt is short.

fills.english: It's too small for me. Give me a big size.
It's too big for me. Give me a small size.

lines.english: No, it's too big for me.

lessons.tip: Мне + велико / мало / подходит = 'for me it is too big / too small / it fits'. No verb and no agreement, so it's a ready-made chunk.

lessons.title: Supermarket

sentences.target: Литр молока и килограмм яблок, пожалуйста.
sentences.english: A litre of milk and a kilo of apples, please.
sentences.translit: Litr moloka i kilogramm yablok, pozhaluysta.

sentences.english: How much is a pack of cheese?
A bottle of water is cheap.

fills.english: I need a litre of milk.
Give me a kilo of apples, please.
There's a special offer today! Everything is cheap.

lines.english: Do you need a basket or a trolley?

lessons.tip: After quantities (килограмм, литр, грамм, бутылка, упаковка) the thing takes a special ending: литр молока, килограмм яблок. Learn them as chunks.

lessons.title: Shops & gifts

sentences.english: There's fresh bread in the bakery.
Flowers and perfume are a good gift.

fills.english: Fresh bread is in the bakery.

lines.english: I want to buy a gift.

lessons.tip: For 'I bought / I'm buying a thing' learn chunks: я купил подарок, я хочу купить цветы. Things in -а change to -у (зарядку), but chunks keep it simple.

lessons.title: The home

sentences.english: My flat is small but new.
The kitchen and bathroom are next to each other.
There's a big window in the bedroom.
I live on the fifth floor.
The lift is there and the balcony is here.

fills.english: I live on the fifth floor.
I want to sleep in the bedroom.

lines.english: Do you have a big flat?
No, a small one. But there's a balcony.

lessons.tip: Gender-by-ending still works at home: дом, балкон, лифт (he); квартира, кухня, спальня (she); окно (it). Watch дверь and ванная: дверь ends in -ь but is she.

lessons.title: Furniture

sentences.target: В комнате есть стол и стул.
sentences.english: There's a table and a chair in the room.
sentences.translit: V komnate yest' stol i stul.

sentences.english: The fridge is in the kitchen.
The mirror is in the bathroom.

sentences.target: У меня есть компьютер и лампа.
sentences.english: I have a computer and a lamp.
sentences.translit: U menya yest' komp'yuter i lampa.

fills.english: The fridge is in the kitchen.

lines.english: What do you have in your room?
A bed, a table and a computer.

lessons.tip: 'I see / I bought' + thing: masculine things don't change (я вижу стол, я купил диван), but -а things switch to -у (я вижу лампу). Learn them as chunks first.

lessons.title: Morning routine

sentences.english: In the morning I don't want to get up.
I want to take a shower.
I don't want to tidy up.

sentences.target: Вечером я хочу ложиться спать рано.
sentences.english: In the evening I want to go to bed early.
sentences.translit: Vecherom ya khochu lozhit'sya spat' rano.

sentences.target: Я не хочу идти на работу!
sentences.english: I don't want to go to work!
sentences.translit: Ya ne khochu idti na rabotu!

fills.english: I don't want to get up.
I need to take a shower every day.
In the evening I want to go to bed.

lines.english: Do you want to get up early in the morning?

lines.target: А я всегда вовремя на работе!
lines.english: I'm always on time at work!
lines.translit: A ya vsegda vovremya na rabote!

lessons.tip: Verbs ending in -ться / -ться are reflexive: you do it to yourself. просыпаться, умываться, одеваться. The -ся means 'self'. Use them after хочу / нужно in the infinitive.

lessons.title: -ать verbs

sentences.english: Do you know where the station is?

fills.english: Do you know where the station is?

lines.english: I'm listening to music. And you?

lessons.tip: Most verbs follow one pattern: drop -ть and add я -ю, ты -ешь, он/она -ет, мы -ем, вы -ете, они -ют. работать → я работаю, ты работаешь, они работают.

lessons.title: -ить verbs
lessons.tip: Verbs in -ить / -еть: я -ю, ты -ишь, он -ит, мы -им, вы -ите, они -ят. говорить → я говорю, ты говоришь, они говорят. Watch the 'я' form: люблю, вижу.

lessons.title: I like

sentences.english: Most of all I love sleeping.

sentences.target: Это совсем не скучно, это интересно.
sentences.english: It's not boring at all, it's interesting.
sentences.translit: Eto sovsem ne skushno, eto interesno.

fills.english: I'm very bored. I want to go home.

lines.english: Yes, I adore it! And you?

lines.target: Я не люблю кофе. Я люблю чай.
lines.english: I don't like coffee. I like tea.
lines.translit: Ya ne lyublyu kofe. Ya lyublyu chay.

lessons.tip: Я люблю + noun or infinitive: я люблю кофе, я люблю спать. To flip it, just add не: я не люблю пиво. Add очень or больше всего to turn the volume up.

lessons.title: Hobbies

sentences.target: Я люблю футбол, а мой брат любит теннис.
sentences.english: I like football and my brother likes tennis.
sentences.translit: Ya lyublyu futbol, a moy brat lyubit tennis.

lessons.tip: Verbs in -овать swap that ending for -у-: путешествовать → я путешествую, ты путешествуешь, они путешествуют. рисовать → я рисую.

lessons.title: Sport

sentences.english: Tomorrow I have a training session.
Our team wants to win the match.

lessons.tip: кататься на + thing is a chunk: кататься на лыжах (skis), кататься на велосипеде (bike). Learn the whole phrase; don't build it from 'ski'.

lessons.title: Going out

sentences.english: Shall we go to a bar on Friday?
Shall we go for a walk?

fills.english: Shall we go to the cinema?
Shall we go to a concert?
Shall we go to a restaurant?

lines.target: Что ты делаешь в пятницу вечером?
lines.english: What are you doing on Friday evening?
lines.translit: Shto ty delayesh' v pyatnitsu vecherom?

lines.english: Shall we go to the cinema?

lessons.tip: Пойдём + где: в for places (в кино, в клуб, в бар), на for events (на концерт, на вечеринку, на выставку, на прогулку). Learn each place with its little word.

lessons.title: The weekend

sentences.english: What are you doing at the weekend?
I like to relax at the weekend.
Shall we go to the cinema? Good idea!

sentences.target: Жаль, я занят. Но в субботу обязательно!
sentences.english: Pity, I'm busy. But on Saturday, definitely!
sentences.translit: Zhal', ya zanyat. No v subbotu obyazatel'no!

fills.english: What are you doing at the weekend?

lines.english: What are you doing at the weekend?

lessons.tip: Чем ты занимаешься? ('what are you into?') uses the instrumental case, so don't build it: learn it whole, just like Что ты делаешь?
